critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx hero rewrite is clean — single occurrence of each testid, no orphan duplicate blocks left over from the sed cleanup.
Consider adding data-testid to the CONTINUE hint (e.g. hero-scroll-hint) for future-proof selection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /lp hero layout is now a single-column flow (audience subtitle → stacked photos → title → CTAs). If testing photo stacking via bbox, do NOT rely on getBoundingClientRect for horizontal alignment because .tmf-cinema uses scale(1.15) Ken Burns transform that shifts bbox; use parent's className ('flex flex-col') or offsetHeight/offsetTop of the container. TriangleButton testids on Field.jsx are `${testid}-plus` (up ▲) and `${testid}-minus` (down ▼), not `-up`/`-down`.
